lessons: Back positive Asian Handicap (+0.5, +1.5, +2.5) selections even with small model-to-breakeven deficits (<3%): positive handicap cushions went 11 of 11.
Do not veto Over 1.5 goals at 1.20–1.29 solely due to a LOSING framework record; Over 1.5 hit reliably when vetoed.
Do not veto Double Chance '12' when missing player value exceeds 20%: heavy squad disruption produced decisive winners without a single draw.
Never apply Double Chance '12' lay-the-draw veto rules to 'Team or Draw' (1X/X2): 1X/X2 provides true draw protection.
Do not blanket veto Double Chance '12' for LOSING framework records: restrict vetoes strictly to tightly priced domestic derbies without squad disparity.
Do not veto team Over 0.5 goals simply because model chance is slightly below break-even: backed and vetoed team Over 0.5 picks frequently score.
Exercise caution backing team Over 0.5 against dominant favorites or away sides: backed selections lost against elite defenses.
Do not blanket veto 'Win to Nil — no' at <=1.24 on framework records: most selections win unless the favorite's defense is entirely intact.
Do not treat Under 4.5 or Under totals as automatic safe cushions: short odds unders can still fail.
Back Under 3.5 in cup ties only when verified extreme squad rotation (missing value share >50%) suppresses offensive output.
football.summary: Refined lessons to reinforce high-performing positive Asian Handicap selections and clarify boundary conditions for goals and double-chance markets based on recent verdict outcomes.

lessons: Veto 1st half totals when the identical matchup is documented in recent mistakes, regardless of an overall winning family record (saved 2 of 2 losses).
Back 1st half Unders when the total line is below 120.0 points at odds 1.90 or higher (won 10 of 11); avoid or reduce stake on Unders at 120.5 or higher (lost 4 of 6).
When the framework record for a betting family is LOSING, apply a downward adjustment to the model probability and back with lower confidence at odds of 1.90 or higher (won 4 of 4).
Do not back 1st half totals at odds below 1.90 unless the model probability exceeds 0.65.
Back NBA underdog handicaps (+1.5) with lower confidence when model probability exceeds 0.58, accepting odds between 1.70 and 1.85 (won 2 of 3).
nba.summary: Retained all five current lessons as they continue to be validated by the graded verdicts and accurately govern odds thresholds, family record adjustments, and total line filters.
